description:
Search FDA medical device adverse event reports (MAUDE) — injuries, malfunctions, deaths.

Example searches:
- 'device.generic_name:pacemaker' — pacemaker events
- 'event_type:death' — events resulting in death

search.description: OpenFDA search query. Examples: 'field:value', 'field:"Exact Phrase"', 'field:[20200101+TO+20231231]', '_exists_:field'. Combine with '+AND+', '+OR+', '+NOT+'.

name: fda_device_events
